signals.rationale: The speaker begins her statement with the word "Maybe," explicitly signaling a lack of full commitment to her suggestion. This verbal cue is accompanied by nonverbal behaviors such as looking away and down, and a soft, hesitant tone of voice, all of which strongly support the label of uncertainty.
The speaker maintains steady eye contact and an upright posture while delivering her message. Her voice is clear and steady, and she speaks fluently without any filler words or hesitation.
